name: mscse-4plus1-research-course-not-shared
description: §3.5 (Sept-2026 revision draft): 'one or two 3-credit CSE REGULAR courses at the 60000 level or higher' — a 4+1 student's undergraduate CSE 60641 (a regular course) draws the shared bachelor's-and-MSCSE credit as usual, but their CSE 68901 (M.S. Thesis Direction, course_type research) does not: it is not a regular course, and (DGS 2026-09-12) a master's project or thesis must be earned while enrolled in the MSCSE, not picked up as an undergraduate elective.

CSE 68901: must be earned while enrolled in the MSCSE program
